items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: Well, in a short while I was playing with Buddy Fisher, playing both tuba and string bass

ctx.x: You were already on the road, though.

Oh, yes. Well, you see, that was in Chicago. Uh-huh. That was the time when, uh, when the bands were using tuba. So I figured they weren't using much bass fiddles anymore, and that it let, well, it reduced the feel down to only a few chances of playing. So before they did, before they came to the climax, I was ready. I went to Hamburg and I bought myself a tuba, and I started taking lessons from him, and naturally I knew all the music and everything. The only thing I had to worry about was the keys and the lip,…
Well, let's come back to the Orange Wheel ahead of us ourselves, don't we? Uh, supposedly said that you were around 17 or 18 years old. You were playing a lot of music then, huh?
